findings.claim: The three paginated getSubGroupsStream(...) overloads in GroupAdapter (lines 256, 262, 268) still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. They throw a NullPointerException when the group is deleted concurrently, which is reachable through the GET /admin/realms/{realm}/groups/{id}/children endpoint.

verifier.reason: In model/infinispan/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/cache/infinispan/GroupAdapter.java:256, 262, and 268, all three paginated getSubGroupsStream overloads still dereference modelSupplier.get() without a null check, throwing a NullPointerException if a cached group is concurrently deleted from the database (unlike getSubGroupsCount at lines 274-275, which this patch fixed). This is reachable via GET /admin/realms/{realm}/groups/{id}/children in services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/GroupResource.java:180, which invokes group.getSubGroupsStream(search, exact, -1, -1) on the cached GroupAdapter.

findings.claim: The regression test never joins the background reader thread before asserting on caughtExceptions. The assertion runs immediately after deletedAll.set(true), so exceptions from in-flight reads can be missed and the thread can outlive the test.

verifier.reason: In tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/tests/admin/group/GroupTest.java:139-149, createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts an unreferenced background Thread via new Thread(...).start() and never joins it.
